title: Woman Watching Elephant at Zoo, 1950s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage 1950s square deckle-edge snapshot capturing a woman from behind with her hands on her hips as she looks over a fence at an elephant at a zoo enclosure. She wears classic mid-century fashion including a white sleeveless blouse tucked into a high-waisted plaid skirt with a dark short hairstyle.
